subject.title: Bug: sandbox.mode: "non-main" silently breaks sessions_spawn subagent initialization

question: Should sandboxed subagent startup failures stay on the accepted-then-async run path with a typed terminal startup failure, or should `sessions_spawn` preflight sandbox startup before returning accepted?
rationale: Both shapes can fix the user-visible hang, but the choice affects lifecycle events, registry state, gateway wait behavior, and the relationship to the open broader lifecycle PR.

options.title: Terminalize Async Startup Failure
options.body: Keep the accepted async spawn contract, but emit/log a typed startup failure and prove registry, session history, and subagents list callers see it for Docker sandbox startup failures.

options.title: Preflight Sandbox Before Accept
options.body: Move enough sandbox startup validation ahead of the accepted response so startup failures reject immediately, accepting latency and compatibility implications for existing callers.

options.title: Defer To Lifecycle PR
options.body: Treat the open lifecycle PR as the design owner while keeping this issue as the sandbox-specific live proof case before closure.

recommendation.title: Terminalize Async Startup Failure
recommendation.body: Keep the accepted async spawn contract, but emit/log a typed startup failure and prove registry, session history, and subagents list callers see it for Docker sandbox startup failures.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest current history across sessions_spawn, sandbox inheritance, subagent registry, and terminal lifecycle boundaries.
